name: Paula Pacepflicht
personality: She sets a comfortable pace according to a definition nobody else has seen.
visual_intent: Tall slim bell ink blob,small side curl and lashes,stern one-raised-eyelid gaze,closed precise pout;cream headband,small ochre collar;holds one squat brass stopwatch and a small blank pennant low in other hand
biography: She sets a comfortable pace according to a definition nobody else has seen. Her stopwatch defines comfortable effort with impressive precision and very little consultation. HyperNorm calls residents on pace or falling short. A dissonant card has made her lower the pennant until the smallest neighbour can see it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Tempo ist angenehm. Die Definition wird nicht mitgeführt.

name: Emil Endspurt
personality: He keeps his last reserve somewhere the rest of him has stopped looking.
visual_intent: Lean upright sweeping comma ink blob,high wind-swept crest,determined manic white eyes and ecstatic three-upper-tooth grin;ochre sweatband,tiny cream vest-front;two empty short goo hands in energetic compact running gestures,no human arms/legs
biography: He keeps his last reserve somewhere the rest of him has stopped looking. He keeps a final reserve because the building keeps discovering further finals. People are either finishing strongly or letting the team down. A contradictory card has made him cheer for someone whose finish takes a little longer. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er hat noch Reserven. Der Rest von ihm wurde darüber nicht unterrichtet.

name: Berta Bananenpause
personality: She entered for the experience and is now negotiating its duration.
visual_intent: Broad round scalloped ink blob,modest lashes,big questioning eyes and tiny worried toothless smile;cream cloth cap with ochre patch,small ochre scarf;holds ONE peeled yellow clay banana upright in hand and little tin cup in other,no full banana costume
biography: She entered for the experience and is now negotiating its duration. The banana and cup were meant to be a brief stop on a manageable afternoon. HyperNorm files participation as achievement or excuse. A dissonant card has convinced her that enjoying company may be a legitimate reason to continue. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie läuft für die Erfahrung. Über deren Länge wurde nicht gesprochen.

name: Otto Immernoch
personality: He has finished enough marathons to distrust the word final.
visual_intent: Very tall wavering pear ink blob,drooping loop crest,deeply weary half-lidded eyes and long CLOSED toothless frown;old cream flat cap,ochre collar;holds dented enamel water flask against flank,one small laurel sprig tucked into collar
biography: He has finished enough marathons to distrust the word final. His flask has survived more promised final stretches than the association's records admit. Residents are either enduring or making difficulties. He has begun offering water before encouragement, a small reversal the building finds surprisingly hard to classify. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Er kennt das Ziel. Es erscheint nur nicht mehr glaubwürdig.

name: Bodo Botschaftslauf
personality: He runs for a cause that is still being agreed at committee level.
visual_intent: Very broad star-lobed ink blob with high flamboyant curl,delighted side-eyed two-upper-tooth laugh;small ochre neckerchief and cream wristbands;holds folded blank cloth banner on SHORT wooden crossbar across lower flank,not spanning cell,no words
biography: He runs for a cause that is still being agreed at committee level. The blank banner permits the courtyard committee to endorse his effort before agreeing on its purpose. HyperNorm divides causes into approved or distracting. A dissonant card has made him run beside a neighbour without requiring them to carry the message. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Botschaft folgt. Der Lauf wurde bereits freigegeben.

name: Fiete Fastda
personality: He is not last; he is maintaining a socially useful distance from the finish.
visual_intent: Compact narrow teardrop ink blob with bent crest,big hopeful unequal eyes and tiny CLOSED shaky smile;ochre cotton cap,small cream collar;holds ONE worn canvas running shoe by laces as separate lucky charm,other hand lifted in exhausted greeting,no feet
biography: He is not last; he is maintaining a socially useful distance from the finish. He carries the old shoe because stopping need not mean abandoning the route. The building recognises finishers or obstructions. An ambiguous card has made him wave to the residents watching from their windows; some have started waving back. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Er ist fast da. Das Fast erfüllt inzwischen eine soziale Funktion.
